name: Shaman
lore: Master of the primordial elements: plant autonomous totems, enchant weapons with Windfury or Flame, and call down lightning shocks.

resource.name: Totems
resource.tip: Plant up to four elemental totems (Earth, Fire, Water, Air). Each totem acts at the start of your turn until destroyed.
resource.rules: Summon totems across four elemental slots to provide passive attacks, shields, and buffs each turn. Enchant your weapons with Imbues to add bonus damage and status effects to every melee strike.

archetypes.name: Elemental Combat
archetypes.text: Shocks, bolts and fire totems: burn the room down.

archetypes.name: Enhancement
archetypes.text: Weapon imbues and Stormstrike: melee with thorns and Windfury.

archetypes.name: Restoration
archetypes.text: Healing totems, Chain Heal and mana: outlast everything.

relics.name: Ankh
relics.text: The first time each combat you fall below 25% HP, heal 12 HP.

relics.name: Earthfury Helmet
relics.text: At the start of each turn, 35% chance to gain 1 Energy.
